summary: The documents describe various methods for handling HTML string manipulations and URL hashing for web applications. Key functionalities include generating HTML links with JavaScript new window calls, handling image icons, translating new lines to HTML breaks, and managing user roles and session parameters for URL construction.
purpose: The main purpose is to facilitate the construction and manipulation of HTML content and URLs within a web application framework, ensuring the correct parameters are passed and user roles are respected in link generation and visibility.
